commands: color-2: Color selected cards: orange (In Progress)
create-starter-board: Create a starter board (color legend and first cards)
extract: Extract current selection to a new card
fold-direction-in: Fold direction: incoming (cards pointing to it)
fold-direction-out: Fold direction: outgoing (cards it points to)
reset-skill: Reset agent skill to the plugin's version (overwrites your edits)
restore: Restore archived card (from its archive note)
select-children: Select children (all levels down, in the fold direction)
select-same-color: Select cards with the same color
select-same-tag: Select cards with the same tag
split-bullet: Split card by top-level bullet
template-save: Save selected cards as a template
tidy-direction-bt: Tidy layout direction: bottom to top
tidy-direction-lr: Tidy layout direction: left to right
tidy-direction-rl: Tidy layout direction: right to left
tidy-direction-tb: Tidy layout direction: top to bottom
